name: Library walk
description: A first-person walk down an endless corridor of book spines toward a warm exit light, after the old 3D maze screensaver.
choices: Brick maze walls become shelves of spines in one-point perspective; the floating exit becomes a lit doorway
Spines use brand navy, steel, paper and tan; the floor keeps a wooden warmth
motion: A slow, continuous walk forward: shelves, floor joints and beams glide past and loop every twelve seconds.
typography: DejaVu Sans Bold, plain outlined wordmark
